title: CI pipeline on GitHub Actions

user_story.i_want: every PR automatically checked for formatting, lints and tests

description: Add `.github/workflows/ci.yml` triggered on pull_request and pushes to master: install the stable toolchain with clippy and rustfmt, cache with rust-cache, then run `cargo fmt --all --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --workspace`. Later, sqlx compile-time checked queries need `SQLX_OFFLINE=true` plus committed `.sqlx/` metadata (see STR-301). Integration tests that need Docker are marked `#[ignore]` and get their own job in STR-505.

acceptance_criteria.given: a PR introducing a clippy warning
a second run on the same branch
acceptance_criteria.then: the rust-cache step reports a cache hit and the run is faster
a CI status badge is shown

rust_concepts: How clippy lints teach idiomatic Rust
`--all-targets` also checks tests, examples and benches
